title: Jawun Evans
text: Jawun Evans (born July 26, 1996) is an American basketball player for the Los Angeles Clippers of the National Basketball Association (NBA). A point guard, he played college basketball for Oklahoma State, Evans was named an All-American in the 2016–17 season.

title: Respect to Mehmetçik Monument
text: The Respect to Mehmetçik Memorial (Turkish: "Mehmetçiğe Saygı Anıtı" ) is a monument in the Gallipoli peninsula, Turkey. Mehmetçik is a common name given to soldiers in a war, just like G.I..
